acceptance.given: The subprocess capability implementation is present and is subject to the SM-A20 shell restriction.

oracle.expected: The capability definition contains an explicit shell=False declaration, and the targeted unit assertion observes that declaration.
forbidden: The capability permits shell evaluation or lacks an explicit shell=False declaration.
oracle.observable: The subprocess capability source and its targeted unit assertion both expose shell=False.

acceptance.when: The targeted unit validation inspects the subprocess capability implementation and evaluates its shell setting.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the subprocess capability shell-setting assertion and fail when the implementation does not explicitly declare shell=False.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure subprocess capability execution explicitly disables shell evaluation and is covered by a targeted assertion.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior subprocess execution implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: The subprocess capability changes from lacking a verified shell restriction to an implementation and test state that explicitly enforces shell=False.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted unit validation observes shell=False in the subprocess capability implementation and passes.
